purpose: Fix pilot for figure form quality: flow loss spatially reweighted toward latent cells whose ground-truth alpha footprint contains figure pixels (max-pooled over each cell's 4-frame x 8x8-pixel footprint; weight 4 vs 1 for empty background cells, per-sample mean-normalized). Rationale: the transparent background dominates the 64x64 frame, so unweighted latent MSE spends most of its gradient on empty cells; max pooling is chosen because thin limbs vanish under average pooling. Latent-space analogue of the pixel track's foreground weight 2, raised to 4 because pooled cell coverage dilutes per-pixel contrast. Matched to the plain start-aligned H8 2k control.

frozen_model.backbone: full spatiotemporal DiT with signed local temporal and spatial 3D RoPE
frozen_model.teacher_forcing: clean ground-truth history during training; generated history during rollout

validation.claim_limit: A two-thousand-step single-seed pilot diagnoses spatial-gradient allocation; it is not a final architecture ranking.
